entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioner has filed this petition under Section 528 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashing of charge-sheet filed against petitioner under Sections 420, 409, 120-B of IPC, Section 66-C & 66-D of Information Technology Act 2008 and Section 13(2) of Prevention and Corruption Act, 1988.
2. Counsel appearing for petitioner on earlier date had made submission that there is no evidence against petitioner.
On said argument, this Court granted time to Government Advocate to apprise this Court regarding incriminating material available against the petitioner.
3. Today, Government Advocate appearing for State submitted that he has sought some clarification from Investigating Officer.
He needs some more time to argue the case.
4. As a last opportunity, two weeks' time is granted to Government Advocate for seeking information and arguing the case.
5. List the matter in week commencing 27.01.2025.
